So I'm departing from our agreement and telling you before I act: I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. I won't hide what I'm doing. If you have a better plan, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. The storm odds make waiting for 8 near-fatal. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.
